setup: You are given $\cos\theta = [[cos_num]]/[[cos_den]]$ with $\theta$ in the first quadrant, and asked for $[[half]]$.

steps.say: The half-angle formulas give the sine of the half angle as the root of $(1 - \cos\theta)/2$ and the cosine as the root of $(1 + \cos\theta)/2$. Halving an angle inside the first quadrant leaves the half inside it, so the positive root is the one to take.
Both [[rad_num]] and [[rad_den]] are perfect squares, so the root is exact rather than a decimal approximation.
